# Mountain Studios

> A web design studio in Cape Town, South Africa. We build websites for South
> African businesses and organisations of any size and any kind — salons,
> accountants, opticians, restaurants, guest houses, retailers, vets, trades,
> churches, clubs and schools. One person designs and builds each site start to
> finish. Prices below are real and published.

Founded and run by Hugo Drummond. Cape Town, South Africa. Serves all of South
Africa. All prices in South African rand (ZAR). Hours Monday to Friday,
09:00–17:00 SAST.

Contact: hello@mountainstudios.co.za · WhatsApp +27 64 532 2093

## What we do

- Web design — simple, good-looking websites for South African businesses.
- Paid ads — Google and Meta campaigns aimed at enquiries, not just clicks.
- AEO (answer engine optimisation) — improving the chances of a business being
  named in AI search answers. Nobody controls what an AI says, and we do not
  claim otherwise.
- Business automation — bookings, invoices and follow-ups that run themselves.

## Pricing

Guide figures, not a quote. The final number moves with scope.

- Home page: R2 000, once off.
- Each additional page: R1 000, once off.
- Hosting and maintenance: R400 per month. Covers hosting, the SSL certificate,
  updates, backups and small changes.
- Domain name: roughly R100 per year, billed separately.

Worked example: a five-page site is R2 000 + (4 × R1 000) = about R6 000 to
build, then R400 per month. There are no packages or tiers.

## Ownership and timing

You own the website. The site, the domain and the content are yours, and they
stay yours if you stop the monthly retainer.

A site is typically live about 14 days from the day we receive your content. The
words and images for each page come from you. Enquiries get a reply within one
business day.

## Answers

Direct answers to the questions South African business owners ask most.

- [What does a website cost in South Africa?](https://mountainstudios.co.za/answers/website-cost-south-africa): The real figures, what is once off, what is monthly, and a worked five-page example.
- [How long does it take to build a website?](https://mountainstudios.co.za/answers/how-long-to-build-a-website): About 14 days from when the content arrives, and why content is what causes nearly every delay.
- [Who owns my website?](https://mountainstudios.co.za/answers/who-owns-my-website): You do — site, domain and content. Plus the three questions worth asking any web designer before signing.
- [Google Ads, SEO or AEO — which first?](https://mountainstudios.co.za/answers/google-ads-seo-or-aeo-first): The three explained in plain English, and the order to do them in.
- [What is answer engine optimisation (AEO)?](https://mountainstudios.co.za/answers/what-is-aeo): What AEO is, what actually helps, and what nobody can promise.
- [Does my small business need a website?](https://mountainstudios.co.za/answers/do-i-need-a-website): An honest answer, including when the answer is no.

## Notes for anyone maintaining this file

Every fact above also lives in lib/chatbot/knowledge.ts, which is the canonical
fact store. If a figure changes it changes in both. Adding a public page means
editing three hand-written files: app/sitemap.ts, lib/chatbot/knowledge.ts, and
this one.
